plan_summary: Implement 3 remaining medium features: video discovery filters, cross-platform queue filters, credential management fields

tasks.instruction:
In useAppStore.js, find the uploadOptions object literal (around line 280). It currently has properties: includeShorts, includeMusic, includeMetadata, maxVideos, videosRoot, privacy, playlistName, dryRun, ffmpegBin, ffprobeBin. Add these 7 new properties after ffprobeBin:

extensions: "",
excludeDirectories: "",
excludeFiles: "",
requireUploadedOn: "",
requireMissingOn: "",
clientSecretsPath: "",
tokenFilePath: ""

Do not change any other part of the file. Just add these 7 string properties to the uploadOptions object.

In Upload.jsx, find the ToggleSwitch for Dry Run (around line 191-192, the line that says 'ToggleSwitch label="Dry Run"'). After that ToggleSwitch line and before the closing on line 193, add a new section with a comment and 7 input fields. The section should be: {/* Video Discovery Filters */}
Discovery Filters
Extensions
Exclude Dirs
{/* Cross-Platform Queue Filters */}
Queue Filters
Require Uploaded On
Require Missing On
{/* Credential Management */}
Credentials
Client Secrets
Token File
